policy: This workplan describes how to produce evidence. It is never a source of PASS status.

criteria.next_action: Execute only MISSING runs from validation/tools/p1_matrix.py using fresh isolated sessions.

criteria.completion_condition: P2_RESULT validator returns VALID and reviewed package is pinned in maturity ledger
criteria.next_action: Freeze the private/fresh P2 preregistration and split commitment, execute only the deterministic MISSING queue, then run `auracode maturity build p2` to create the canonical package. After independent review, use `auracode maturity record MAT-02 ... --confirm-reviewed`.

prerequisites: At least two completed studies using distinct model/agent identities
criteria.completion_condition: REPLICATION validator returns VALID and reviewed package is pinned in maturity ledger
criteria.next_action: Complete validated P2 studies on at least two distinct model/agent pairings, then run `auracode maturity build replication` over the completed P2 packages. Review the generated package before recording MAT-03.

criteria.completion_condition: P3_RESULT validator returns VALID for at least two benchmark families and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Freeze P3 on two or more eligible external benchmark families and execute A0/A1/A2 without collapsing heterogeneous scores.

criteria.completion_condition: P4_RESULT validator returns VALID with PASS load/soak/rollback/recovery/observability and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Run preregistered load, soak, rollback, recovery and observability exercises on a representative safe environment.

criteria.completion_condition: INTER_RATER validator returns VALID with complete paired ratings and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Have at least two independent assessors rate the full selected profile without implementation roles.

criteria.completion_condition: BURDEN_ERRORS validator returns VALID and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Collect real elapsed-time and human-intervention metrics for A0/A1/A2 plus error-calibration counts, then run `auracode maturity build burden`. Missing token/cost/tool-call fields must remain missing. Review before recording MAT-07.

criteria.evidence_package: private multi-language qualification canonical JSON package
criteria.completion_condition: MULTILANG_QUALIFICATION validator returns VALID and maturity_eligible=true, then reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Create an independently labeled private/fresh Python+TypeScript corpus, freeze thresholds and execute qualification. Do not use the public baseline as stable evidence.

criteria.completion_condition: INDEPENDENT_SECURITY_AUDIT validator returns VALID with zero open Critical/High findings and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Commission independent threat-model and supply-chain review using docs/audit/INDEPENDENT-SECURITY-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.

criteria.completion_condition: GOVERNANCE_1_0 validator returns VALID after explicit human adoption and reviewed package is pinned
criteria.next_action: Humans must decide and adopt the governance items in docs/GOVERNANCE-1.0-PROPOSAL.md. AI must not appoint authority.
